title: IZAKA-YA reported sequential transfer and withdrawal processing after individual reviews
description: IZAKA-YA stated that it had not imposed a platform-wide transfer or withdrawal halt, that some reviewed transfers were completed on 2026-08-25, and that remaining cases continued to be processed after individual safety and transaction checks. This follows the operator's 2026-08-24 disclosure of temporary restrictions on some accounts.
notes: This is a continuation/status update to the account-level withdrawal restriction rather than evidence that all restrictions have ended. It records the operator's statement and does not independently verify completion for every affected customer.
